job.job_description:
3 to 5 Years of experienceFull Time

Location: Chennai India.



We are seeking a highly skilled andexperienced Back End Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidateshould have a strong background in backend services, and database management. With 3 to 5 years of industry experience, the candidate should be well-versed in Python for backend services as well as different database management applications.
Responsibilities :

Back-end Services: Design, develop, and maintain server-side applications and APIs usingPython or other similar technologies. Implement robust and scalable solutions to handle dataprocessing, storage, and retrieval.

Database Management: Possess a good understanding of database systems and demonstrate proficiencyin managing relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQLdatabases (e.g., MongoDB).

Full Stack Integration: Work onend-to-end feature development, from conception to deployment, ensuring smooth interaction between the front-end and back-end components.

Testing and Debugging: Conduct thorough testing of applications to identify and fix bugs, performance bottlenecks, and ensurehigh-quality deliverables.

Code Optimization and Performance: Continuously improve application performance andoptimize code for efficiency, scalability, and maintainability.

Collaboration: Coordinate withcross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other developers, to understand project requirements and deliver solutions on time.



Qualifications :

Bachelors or Master degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Proven 3 to 5 years of professional experience as a Back End Developer, with a portfolio of successful projects.

Strong proficiency in backend services using Python.

Solid understanding of databasemanagement and experience working with managing relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).

Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile development methodologies.

Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Effective communication skills to articulate technical
